additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Portofino · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Twenty-seven own-project renders cover the complete building, private/shared pools, podium amenities, recreation, lobby and home interiors. All 47 native resources and six primary gallery files were visually reviewed against the complete brochure index. Italian village scenes, generic travel/people imagery, blank masks and corporate imagery are excluded. The primary’s complete building supplies the hero and listing card. The living room and lounge are accurately labeled. Source-baked captions remain intact. No kitchen scene is claimed.
review.floorPlans: Three complete official home sheets show studio, 1 BR and 2 BR pool layouts. Seven complete building floorplates from the branded Jiwak broker mirror cover floors 1–11. The first-floor indoor gym and all source legends remain visible. These sheets do not print numerical home areas or establish contractual numbered-unit matching. Confirm the selected home, area and pool provision with SAMANA. All three home sheets on physical pages 35–37 and all seven mirror floorplates on physical pages 2–8 were visually reviewed in full. The source’s seventh-floor typographic error remains visible without copying that error into the selector. Brochure page 34 is a facade/title page and is excluded from the drawing choices. No category minimum or component dimension is used as a home total.
review.location: The complete physical page 38 Dubai map and all twelve travel entries on page 39 were visually reviewed. The Italian harbour photograph accompanying the travel panel is excluded from the project gallery. Current-primary travel differences and historical school identities are explicitly qualified. The published name-only map query retains its primary HTML hash. No entrance coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Original official primary HTML, brochure, native image origins and complete Jiwak branded floorplate PDF have source receipts and SHA256 checks. The plan mirror is labeled honestly. Complete pages, legends and original physical PDF-page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, contractual numbered-unit matching, resolution of conflicting travel estimates, current school campus identities, exact visitor entrance coordinates, final unit finishes/views and dated construction photography were not established.
